run_train_svm: run the SVM training script to train and test SVM classifiers on extracted ViSSL features for specified model layers
train_svm_layer: train an SVM classifier on extracted features for a specific model layer and evaluate its test accuracy
extract_features_for_svm: extract model features using distributed launch and save them for downstream SVM training
collect_map_stats: collect and report mean average precision (mAP) statistics across all evaluated model layers
invoke_svm_via_hydra: invoke the SVM training pipeline via Hydra configuration with command-line overrides
